purpose: Which of the records that carry a development figure and an adopted gross written premium at or below zero are in run-off in that year, by their own filings (the author's decision D1, option A as refined, 30 September 2026). A premium sign is not a run-off test: 3623/2018 is a live syndicate whose negative premium is a return premium under a reinsurance contract, and 5183/2024's filing puts its run-off at 1 January 2025. in_runoff is true only where the filing states that the syndicate itself is in run-off, has ceased underwriting or is being wound down during that year; a run-off year of account, and the reinsurance to close of closed years, are not that. A statement that is ambiguous leaves the record where it is (in_runoff false) and the note says why.
premium_adopted_gbp_m: the adopted gross written premium as the record states it, in millions of the currency in premium_currency (the extraction's convention for every _gbp_m field); both models' readings agree for all nine
sources: The local filings: syndicate_reports/pdfs (the converted PDF in pdf_extraction/html_converted for the two HTML-only filings). source_page is 1-based in the file source_sha256 hashes (the converted PDF for an HTML filing) and source_page_printed is the number printed on the page. Each quote in evidence and other_statements is verbatim from the page cited (white space collapsed; ' ... ' marks words left out); tests/test_runoff_register.py holds each to its page.
